title: Set structure
rules: Each set contains exactly ten distinct, recognizable subjects connected by one specific theme.
Subjects complement one another with varied roles, silhouettes and materials; a shared color alone is insufficient.
Every set includes all four composition categories. The planned allocation must match the ten cards.
Generate exactly the number of sets selected by the producer; one set is the default.

title: Content constraints
rules: Produce ordinary object illustrations without gold-rarity character scenes, people, brands, text, rarity badges or interface frames.
Keep the main subject complete and readable in portrait 43:48 format; preserve the artistic background.
The producer's theme changes subjects and mood while the active rendering rules define the artistic treatment.

title: Production and quality checks
rules: Validate the subject plan and shared art direction before generating images.
Verify a pilot card before producing the remaining cards.
Compare every card against original art and its assigned composition category.
Review all ten cards together against clean original sets; repair outliers within the configured limits.
Export only when the current card versions and complete set have passed the required checks.

title: Image brief and reference use
rules: Define one deliverable and its use. Describe the scene, subject, visible details and constraints in labeled sections.
Specify subject shape, materials and texture; resolve lighting direction, softness, highlights and shadows from original art.
State viewpoint, orientation, relative scale, placement, framing, negative space and background depth for the assigned category.
Define concrete colors, subject/background contrast and rendering medium. Avoid vague quality slogans, unnecessary camera settings and photographic genre drift.
Identify every input image by number and purpose. Transfer only declared rendering or category evidence; exclude source subjects, UI and layout. Originals outrank supplemental examples.

For revisions, supply the previous candidate, request the smallest coherent correction and restate what must remain. The candidate is an edit base, never style authority; preservation is subordinate to the accepted plan.
Exclude unrelated objects, text, logos, watermarks, frames and people. Check the complete silhouette, materials, lighting, category and thumbnail readability against the approved brief.
